reason: The cited evidence (E1) shows force-matching (via DNN) on a high-entropy carbonitride at 3500 K, but does not address CoCrFeMnNi, TI path mismatch, or the specific quantitative claims. premises: Force-matched potentials can be trained on ab initio MD data to capture complex many-body interactions in liquid HEAs.
Such potentials will provide closer phase-space overlap than EAM references for thermodynamic integration.
The TI path mismatch will be reduced by ~40% relative to TOR-TILD's EAM references.
Free-energy predictions will converge to within 10 meV/atom of direct ab initio calculations.
The method is applicable to equiatomic CoCrFeMnNi at Tm ± 50 K.
